WHY THIS NEEDS SUBSTANTIAL AI PROCESSING

Real work creates
a recurring workload.

An acquisition file can include hundreds of scanned pages and several versions of a survey. The AI must read the pages, match parcel references and compare conflicting details across the file.

Planning scenario · not current customer usageEvery new parcel file or document revision
378,000document pages / month
2,100parcel briefs in this scenario
180pages per parcel file
60 organizations×35 parcel files per team / month×1 review per changed file×180 pages per parcel file

The workload is long-document reading and comparison across many acquisition files. Unchanged pages can be cached; new revisions trigger a fresh comparison.

HOW THE JOB GETS DONE

Four steps.
One useful decision.

It prepares a due-diligence brief. It does not confirm ownership, verify a registry entry or replace a lawyer or licensed surveyor.

  1. 01

    Read the parcel file

    Read the supplied pages and record their document references.

  2. 02

    Compare the details

    Check parcel numbers, areas, dates and references across documents.

  3. 03

    List the open questions

    Quote the conflicting passages and identify missing evidence.

  4. 04

    Refer the decision

    A lawyer, surveyor or acquisition lead resolves the question.

A SPECIFIC WORKED EXAMPLE

0.5 ha

document discrepancy, not a title determination

Prepared scenario, not measured customer results.
THE INPUT

A survey lists 8.4 hectares while the title schedule, seven pages into another file, lists 7.9 hectares.

THE USEFUL OUTPUT

The prepared AI brief places both passages beside a 0.5-hectare discrepancy for professional review.
